simple.meaning: תִּרְגַּם (tirgam) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to transfer , i.e. translate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 4:7. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תִּרְגַּם (H8638) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תִּרְגַּם (tirgam) / H8638 is traced through Ezra 4:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.
